features.name: months_since_last_donation
features.description: Recency in months (V1) - lower values indicate more recent donor activity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct recency signal; trees can split on recent vs lapsed donors.

features.name: is_recent_donor
features.description: Boolean flag indicating donation within last 4 months.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a clean threshold split for highly active donors.

features.name: is_lapsed_donor
features.description: Boolean flag indicating no donation in over 12 months.
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies inactive donors which is a strong split signal.

features.name: donation_frequency_bucket
features.expected_model_benefit: Pre-bucketed frequency aids tree splits without deep depth.

features.name: donation_rate_per_month
features.description: Average donations per month of donation history (V2 / V4).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures intensity of donor engagement over their history.

features.name: active_donation_months
features.description: Months between first donation and last donation (V4 - V1), gives active span.

features.name: avg_gap_between_donations
features.description: Average months between consecutive donations over the active span.
features.expected_model_benefit: Low gap indicates regular donor habit; useful threshold split.

features.name: recency_to_tenure_ratio
features.description: Ratio of months since last donation to total donor tenure (V1 / V4).
features.expected_model_benefit: Higher ratio indicates donor went silent late in tenure; nonlinear signal.

features.name: log_total_volume
features.description: Log-scaled total cc donated (log1p of V3) to compress heavy tail.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compressed scale gives cleaner thresholds for trees on skewed volume.

features.name: volume_per_donation_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of average volume per donation from canonical 250cc unit.
features.expected_model_benefit: Detects anomalous volume/donation ratios that may signal data quirks.

features.name: engaged_recent_donor
features.description: Interaction flag: recent donor (V1<=4) AND frequent (V2>=5).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the joint effect of recency and frequency in a single split.

features.name: donor_loyalty_score
features.description: Semantic ordinal score of donor loyalty profile combining tenure span, frequency, and recency: 0=one-shot inactive, 1=occasional, 2=regular, 3=highly loyal recent donor. Derived from row values only.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a compact semantic grouping that trees can split into loyalty tiers.
